{{Quote|If I listen, does that mean you won't shoot me? Because that seems out of character.''"<br />"''Good point. Don't we usually shoot them anyway...?|Voidhound and the soldier|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
This '''Imperial soldier''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] serving in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3642 BBY]]. He was part of a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] contingent that intercepted a renowned [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-aligned [[Voidhound|smuggler]] during the latter's [[Mission to the Okara Droid Factory|infiltration]] of the [[Okara Droid Factory]], and was killed in the ensuing fight.
